purpose: Faculty submits research proposal from Draft to Submitted
action_or_input: Validate transition from PROPOSAL_STATUS_DRAFT to PROPOSAL_STATUS_SUBMITTED_HOD
expected_result: Both status constants are defined and distinct

purpose: HoD recommends research proposal advancing to RECOMMENDED_HOD
action_or_input: Verify HoD recommend permission and target status RECOMMENDED_HOD
expected_result: RECOMMENDED_HOD status is valid in choices

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies proposal advancing to VERIFIED_ADMIN
action_or_input: Verify admin verify permission and target status VERIFIED_ADMIN
expected_result: VERIFIED_ADMIN status is valid in choices

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves proposal advancing to APPROVED_DEAN
preconditions: Proposal budget < 10 Lakhs and admin verified

purpose: Dean-RSPC forwards large funding proposal to Director
preconditions: Proposal budget >= 10 Lakhs and admin verified
action_or_input: Check is_director_approval_required is True and status FORWARDED_DIRECTOR
expected_result: FORWARDED_DIRECTOR status is valid in choices

purpose: Director authorizes large funding proposal advancing to APPROVED_DIRECTOR
action_or_input: Verify director authorization permission and APPROVED_DIRECTOR status
expected_result: APPROVED_DIRECTOR status is valid in choices

purpose: Consultancy project approved at Dean-RSPC level

expected_result: Consultancy Dean approval path is valid

purpose: High-value consultancy (>= 10 Lakhs) routed to Director for approval
expected_result: Returns True requiring Director approval for consultancy

purpose: Staff appointment approved at Dean-RSPC level
preconditions: Staff appointment requested and selection recorded
action_or_input: Inspect ProjectStaffAppointment status and Dean management permissions
expected_result: Staff appointment captures REQUESTED status and Dean has manage permission

purpose: High-value staff appointment routed to Director
preconditions: Staff appointment with senior position requiring Director sanction

purpose: Financial request approved at Dean-RSPC level (< 2 Lakhs)

purpose: Financial request escalated and approved via Director (>= 2 Lakhs)

purpose: Procurement request approved at Dean-RSPC level (< 2 Lakhs)

purpose: Procurement request escalated to Director (>= 2 Lakhs)
